notes: Examined `for (uint256 index = 1; index < _vestingConfigs.length; index++)` and the inner loop over `projectConfig.schedule.length`. The iteration is bounded by a storage array, which is the shape this class names, and the array has exactly one writer in the analysed unit: `initialize()`, guarded by `whenNotInitialized()`, pushing from `params.vestingConfigs` after `_validateSharesAndVests`. It cannot grow after initialisation at all, so no caller -- privileged or not -- can lengthen the work this loop does. Not an instance of denial_of_service at this location. This says nothing about the rest of the file, and nothing about the report's own H-03, which is a denial of service in `ILOManager.launch` reached through a price check rather than through iteration.
